scope.worker_cpu_allocations: One or two as labeled in each trial.

restore_verification.sampling: Two fresh processes per application and source. Each records one cold and eight warm complete rescans. Both sources retain their original authority digest.
restore_verification.table_profile_method: Four warm read-only scans of each retained file. Each SQLite SELECT interval includes fetching, encoding and verifying that table until the next SELECT or digest return. Percentages use the median whole scan and may not sum to 100.

trial_notes.sequential: Opening trials and competing stock/option pairs ran consecutively. The dense calendar used a separate logical CPU until its follow-up ended. Each competing held-exit pair shared one CPU with the same 124 peer cases. The final shared-CPU pair ran after the dense calendar ended.
trial_notes.installed_system: Held exits from the installed system suite without an additional peer pinned to the same CPU.
trial_notes.overlapping_suites: The earlier measurements also overlapped other local checks. Retained separately.
trial_notes.opening: Quote age at the actual native reservation uses the original quote timestamp. A null age has no observed reservation in the indicated report.
trial_notes.exit: exit_seconds includes setup before the stop book and ends when its tick finishes. Each retained case acknowledged the sell with history, advice and display work blocked and a report open, filled from the next packet, and verified flat.

copy_retry.observed: The sequential pre-repair publisher recorded a RUNNING TimeoutError at the pinned source backup. A separate report trial ended early with REPORT_SOURCE_COPY_DEADLINE.
copy_retry.limits: One pinned SQLite read with the existing 0.5-second cap. The released reader may finish one incremental copy within the original deadline. A further restart ends the attempt.

installed_checks.overlap: The suites overlap. The system skip requires a second mapped UID.

dense_calendar.build: Intermediate exact-prefix build, before the final long-string and concurrent-reader optimizations.

final_application_read_only_audit.verification: current installed application, read-only on the stopped dense calendar account

expired_cycle_trace.note: Individual phase durations can nest. The reply-to-review interval uses the original saved timestamps.

one_cpu_acknowledgement_failure.measurement_limit: These are the stages the parent observed before cleanup. Later reconciliation matched the attempt.

released_copy_repeat.observed: A report-copy timeout triggered the test harness shutdown. The publisher also stopped its last unpinned copy after a writer restart. One entry and no exit fill had been recorded at cutoff.
released_copy_repeat.behavior: Once the pinned reader is released, a writer may restart the incremental copy while it reaches more pages between restarts. Repeated rewinds at the same point abort, with the same original deadline and page limit.

native_worker_startup.scope: Existing native child entrypoint with empty input. It stops at request validation before opening a venue. Module cumulative times may overlap. This probes startup independently of the failed parent trace.

output_from_saved_failed_run: Run execution: entry fills 1; exit fills 1; completed round trips 1; prior-run plays fully exited 0
Order recovery: matched 1; unresolved at last reconciliation 0
Local order acknowledgement calls (measured 2, failed 1, interrupted 0)
